book.under_world.hillside_house.title: Storage Log - Kira_99
book.under_world.hillside_house.page_1:
Day 12.
Finished putting glowstone into the floor today. Looks cozy under the glass roof!

Weird thing though: someone keeps digging right behind my back stone wall every midnight, even when the server player list is empty.
book.under_world.hillside_house.page_2:
Day 14.
Found a flickering static block embedded in the back corner of my chests. I tried mining it and my screen started shaking.

When I stepped onto the front walkway, Steve was standing by the stairs. Not a real player. His head twitched sideways 90 degrees.
book.under_world.hillside_house.page_3:
I locked the door and ran toward the clan terrace.

If anyone finds my house after the server restart, check the chests and DO NOT walk up close to Steve if you see him standing still near the hill.
book.under_world.clan_base_secret.title: ADMIN CONFESSION [BACKUP_14]
book.under_world.clan_base_secret.page_1:
If any of the clan finds this secret room under the floorboards, I am sorry I didn't shut down the host sooner.

Everybody thought 'friend' joining Day 1 was just a harmless cracked-account troll. It wasn't.
book.under_world.clan_base_secret.page_2:
Three nights ago Alex logged off in the dugout, yet his character walked into the courtyard an hour later.

When Misha walked up to ask why Alex wasn't answering Discord, his body burst into black pixels and tore open into four long limbs.
book.under_world.clan_base_secret.page_3:
It caught Misha by the pool. Now it wears HIS skin and HIS nametag on the road between bases.

I purged the console logs and threw away all the server backups so no one would track the seed.
book.under_world.clan_base_secret.page_4:
I hid down here with one redstone torch until the chunks unload. Even underwater isn't safe — something in the bay pulled Dima's oak boat straight down.

Leave the server. Do not touch the floating black sphere in the meadow.
book.under_world.mario_art.title: Pixel Build Notes - Dima_2015
book.under_world.mario_art.page_1:
Almost done building giant Mario out of wool at spawn meadow! Just two rows of red cap and the left scaffold left.

Wait. Who placed that glitchy cube inside Mario's ear? Nobody else has perms near my plot.
book.under_world.mario_art.page_2: Daylight suddenly snapped black for three seconds while I was on the ladder. When I looked down toward the river, something pitch black with rows of pale fangs surfaced right below the wooden bridge.
book.under_world.mario_art.page_3:
Leaving the wool and shears in the chest. I'm taking a boat across the lake back to Kira's hill — it's faster than walking.

Wait why is my boat dragging backward
book.under_world.monument.title: Server Archive #1
book.under_world.monument.page_1:
Erected in honor of our 2013 Alpha map before the first chunk corruption.

Original founders: Max, Alex_2014, Kira_99, Dima_2015, Leo.
book.under_world.monument.page_2:
Every time we reset the world seed, this statue spawns back in random meadows with one quartz eye missing.

Sometimes at dusk, redstone torches ignite by themselves while the regular torches go out.
book.under_world.monument.page_3:
The archive log ends at timestamp 03:17 with one line repeated forty times:

'this server is ^&^#&* please leave server the truth is here'
book.under_world.treehouse.title: Lookout Notes - Misha_Play
book.under_world.treehouse.page_1:
Built this lookout high in the big oak canopy so nothing from the forest could reach the ladder.

I swore I saw Alex standing under the trunk twenty minutes ago staring straight up.
book.under_world.treehouse.page_2: His neck snapped sideways twice without moving his feet. I pulled the hatch shut and tossed my bow down the ladder gap—wait no, I hear wet footsteps splashing below.
book.under_world.treehouse.page_3: Whatever that thing is, it doesn't stay disguised once you get close. I'm jumping out the north leaves toward the clan compound lights.
book.under_world.dugout.title: Hideout Entry - Alex_2014
book.under_world.dugout.page_1:
Dug a small bunker under the grass hill and masked the trapdoor with dirt.

A floating black sphere drifted across the plains yesterday. It stretched wide and shrank like it was breathing.
book.under_world.dugout.page_2: Leo accidentally brushed against the sphere while running past. He screamed in voice chat that his screen tilted sideways and white triangles filled his eyes until he walked off a ravine.
book.under_world.dugout.page_3: Keeping the iron bars shut. Keep your redstone torch low. If a player knocks above and spells words weird in chat, DO NOT open the hatch.
book.under_world.spawn_hub.title: Server Rules [OLD]
book.under_world.spawn_hub.page_1:
Welcome to UnderCraft (2013-2015)!
1. Respect builds & clan borders.
2. No griefing spawn or pixel art.
3. Check staff board for events.
book.under_world.spawn_hub.page_2:
[MODERATOR NOTICE — LEO]
Ignore any join alerts from 'friend' after 18:00. We did NOT whitelist that account and Mojang session servers return null UUID.
book.under_world.spawn_hub.page_3:
[EMERGENCY LOCKDOWN]
Spawn protection failed. Clock statues are appearing in unloaded chunks. Teleport back to overworld spawn disabled.

EVERYONE LOG OUT NOW.
book.under_world.trading_hall.title: Market Quarantine - Trader_Vova
book.under_world.trading_hall.page_1:
Set up three stalls for emeralds, enchanted books, and iron armor before the clan war.

Sales were booming until Tuesday night when the lamps flickered.
book.under_world.trading_hall.page_2: All three villagers stopped sleeping in their beds at once. They just stood behind the fences staring at the exact same dark hill coordinate outside the door.
book.under_world.trading_hall.page_3:
Closed the oak doors and left my emeralds in the crate.

If you're reading this: don't trade with them after sundown, and don't walk near the river behind the market.
book.under_world.computer_desk.title: PC Troubleshooting - Admin_Max
book.under_world.computer_desk.page_1:
Picked up this beige CRT tower from an abandoned house near the powerlines.

When you right-click the monitor, the entire room blurs into a green Windows XP hill.
book.under_world.computer_desk.page_2:
All the desktop shortcuts turned black and crashed into the grass when I walked up to them — except Chrome.

Inside the browser I found a site called 'the MinECRaT fREe downladn'.
book.under_world.computer_desk.page_3:
NEVER press the green DOWNLOAD button unless you are ready to sprint LEFT immediately.

Break or touch the portal that opens on the left to bring the Computer back with you.
wiki.under_world.title: Under World Wiki
wiki.under_world.entity.friend.name: friend
wiki.under_world.entity.friend.desc:
APPEARANCE: Classic Steve silhouette carrying a cryptic name ('friend' by default), appearing in the server tab list and chat.

BEHAVIOR: Joins once automatically on Day 1 evening (around tick 12500) with a broadcast join alert. Periodically sends unsettling chat lines, peeks around corners, opens doors, builds Void Shrines, and leaves warning signs.

THREAT & INTERACTION: If you type trigger words (hello, who are you, void, hands, tree, fun world, smile), friend replies. Insulting friend triggers punishments (lightning, explosions, or falling anvils). When spotted up close, friend either vanishes or warps you into The Fun World!
wiki.under_world.entity.hands.name: Hands
wiki.under_world.entity.hands.desc:
APPEARANCE: Tall wireframe humanoid with overly long multi-jointed arms and glowing pale gaze.

WHERE IT APPEARS: Spawns deep underground in dark caves (Y < 48, light <= 6).

BEHAVIOR: Sprints relentlessly toward its victim for ~60 seconds before burrowing back into stone. Smashes breakable blocks in its path during pursuit.

LETHAL EFFECT: If Hands catches and kills you (and kick-on-kill is enabled), it disconnects you with: 'Connection lost: something dragged you under.'
wiki.under_world.entity.tree_mimic.name: Tree?
wiki.under_world.entity.tree_mimic.desc:
APPEARANCE: Disguised as an ordinary oak tree until you walk near it.

AWAKENING: Approaching within trigger range cracks the bark open, revealing glowing red eyes and writhing wooden tendrils.

HOW TO DEFEAT: Its bark is immune to ordinary swords or fists for the finishing blow — YOU MUST USE AN AXE to slay Tree? cleanly.
wiki.under_world.entity.the_sky.name: The Sky
wiki.under_world.entity.the_sky.desc:
APPEARANCE: A colossal 8x90-block dark entity towering into the clouds on the distant horizon.

BEHAVIOR: Watches silently from 50-80 blocks away, shaking the air with deep low roars. Approaching it causes it to stomp the ground violently or vanish into mist.

WARNING: Never walk directly underneath its massive legs — being crushed beneath The Sky is fatal.
wiki.under_world.entity.eyes_of_fun.name: Eyes of Fun
wiki.under_world.entity.eyes_of_fun.tag: Nocturnal Flower Stalker | The Fun World
wiki.under_world.entity.eyes_of_fun.desc:
APPEARANCE: Tall yellow daisy-headed stalks with cold staring eyes.

WHERE IT APPEARS: Emerges during nightfall inside The Fun World (where days & nights pass 4x faster).

SURVIVAL RULE: Similar to weeping angels / gaze anomalies — turning your back or looking away allows Eyes of Fun to lunge at lethal speed! Maintain visual contact while backing toward daylight or cover.
wiki.under_world.entity.smile.name: Smile
wiki.under_world.entity.smile.desc:
APPEARANCE: Pitch-black spindly runner with a wide crimson grin and white staring eyes.

WHERE IT APPEARS: Stalks the endless red brick corridors of The Maze.

BEHAVIOR: Hunts with distorted digital shrieks and rapid footsteps down intersecting hallways. Sprint around corners and seek either a glowing Maze Escape Terminal or rift portal.
wiki.under_world.entity.the_truth.name: the truth
wiki.under_world.entity.the_truth.desc:
APPEARANCE: A staggering 50-block tall, 30-block wide black monolith entity with huge white eyes.

EVENT MECHANIC: Splits the earth open ahead of you and triggers a 30-second 'SURVIVE' HUD countdown. Smash-plows through ANY destructible block in its 30x50 corridor.

CONSEQUENCE: Survive 30 seconds and it vanishes. If it catches you, you are kicked ('this server is ^&^#&*') and upon rejoining the server, a 100-block cobblestone pillar spawns underneath you!
wiki.under_world.entity.clock.name: clock
wiki.under_world.entity.clock.desc:
APPEARANCE: Tall slender figure wearing a ticking grandfather clock face.

OVERWORLD BEHAVIOR: Can ambush players on the surface and warp caught victims straight into The Time dimension.

THE TIME VARIANT: Inside The Time, an aggressive ticking variant hunts you across floating clock discs. Freeze when the ticking stops or listen carefully to the chimes while navigating toward the Temporal Exit Portal!
wiki.under_world.entity.the_mimic.name: the_mimic
wiki.under_world.entity.the_mimic.desc:
APPEARANCE: Disguises itself as Steve or copies real server players' skins and nametags on roads and outside bases.

AMBUSH: Walk too close and its neck snaps sideways — its disguise shatters into black glitch pixels, unfolding four terrifying black limbs for a 30-second high-speed chase.

TIP: Check player behavior before trusting someone standing silently near your base!
wiki.under_world.entity.demon_fish.name: Demon Fish
wiki.under_world.entity.demon_fish.desc:
APPEARANCE: Pitch-black aquatic monster lined with pale eyes and serrated pink jaws.

BEHAVIOR: Ambushes players swimming or sailing in boats. Uses its long fleshy tongue to snatch and shatter oak boats, and breaks blocks if you try to box yourself underwater.

TIP: Keep water routes lit or sprint immediately for dry land when you hear jaws snapping beneath the surface.
wiki.under_world.entity.the_ball.name: The Ball
wiki.under_world.entity.the_ball.desc:
APPEARANCE: Floating, breathing pitch-black sphere that warps smoothly into cubes and sharp octahedra.

DANGER: Touching or colliding with The Ball inflicts 20 seconds of 'Geometric Nightmare', severely tilting your screen, filling vision with hallucinations, and humming with deep void resonance.
wiki.under_world.entity.living_pylon.des:
APPEARANCE: Overhauled 8.6-block tall galvanized steel power transmission pylon with articulated cross-arms, warning beacons, dangling live power cables, and glowing red electrical core.

BEHAVIOR: Appears harmless in daylight, but inside The Plains at night (or when spawned), Living Pylon uproots its four lattice legs, emits loud 50Hz humming, and hunts players with arcing electrocution strikes!

TIP: Seek shelter in abandoned apartment blocks or keep moving along the road until dawn.
wiki.under_world.entity.wind_turbine_sta:
APPEARANCE: Massive 10.5-block offshore wind turbine featuring a multi-tiered concrete footing, tapered cylindrical mast, detailed turbine nacelle with cooling vents, 3 sculpted aerodynamic blades, and a crimson stalker eye.

BEHAVIOR: Disguises itself among static wind turbines over the deep grey Wind Ocean. When it awakens, its nacelle unfolds clawing arms and it wades through water toward your boat with deep rotor splashes and howling wind.

TIP: Row hard toward the flaming Oil Rig ahead — avoid straying near lone spinning hubs.
wiki.under_world.entity.the_dot_com.name: The ___.com
wiki.under_world.entity.the_dot_com.desc:
APPEARANCE: Corrupted 4.9-block tall webpage horror stitched from floating browser windows, glowing crimson error tabs, jagged tooth-bars, cursor-clawed arms, and an exposed glitching mainframe core.

AWAKENING: Appears at the corrupted site 'http://the-MinECRaT-fREe-downladn.com/' (+136, -120) inside The Browser when you approach or click the green DOWNLOAD NOW button.

SURVIVAL: Immediately sprint LEFT along the lit escape bridge into the Browser Escape Portal to survive and claim your Old CRT Computer!
wiki.under_world.dim.fun_world.name: The Fun World
wiki.under_world.dim.fun_world.desc:
HOW TO ENTER: Step inside a Void Shrine structure in the Overworld, get warped up close by friend, or use /underworld dimension <player> the_fun_world.

ENVIRONMENT: Vivid nostalgic bright-green hills covered in mushrooms, colorful daisies, and giant red corridor rifts. Time flows 4x faster than the Overworld.

DANGERS & EXIT: At night, Eyes of Fun awaken across the meadow. Locate the tall red brick Maze Rift Portal within the Fun World to enter The Maze and work toward an exit!
wiki.under_world.dim.maze.name: Maze
wiki.under_world.dim.maze.desc:
HOW TO ENTER: Step through the Maze Rift Portal inside The Fun World (or via /underworld dimension).

ENVIRONMENT: Endless enclosed corridors of red brick, wooden planks, and humming office ceiling tiles with zero natural skylight.

DANGERS & EXIT: Smile sprints through the hallways shrieking. Search intersections for the glowing Maze Escape Terminal block — right-click or step on it to return to the Overworld.
wiki.under_world.dim.error.name: The Error
wiki.under_world.dim.error.desc:
HOW TO ENTER: Sleeping in an Overworld bed carries a configurable 20% chance of warping you into The Error instead of waking normally.

ENVIRONMENT: Surreal magenta-tinted corrupted sector filled with floating Glitch Blocks and fractured ground.

SURVIVAL & EXIT: You do not need a portal! Survive the 01:30 'ERROR BUFFER' countdown without falling endlessly, and the connection automatically restores you to your Overworld return point.
wiki.under_world.dim.time.name: The Time
wiki.under_world.dim.time.desc:
HOW TO ENTER: Get caught by clock in the Overworld (or step through a Time Portal / /underworld dimension).

ENVIRONMENT: Golden-dusk void suspended with massive floating clock dial discs above an endless abyss (falling off safely wraps you back onto a disc with Slow Falling).

DANGERS & EXIT: An aggressive ticking clock hunts you across discs. Seek out the glowing Temporal Exit Portal on one of the clocks to return home.
wiki.under_world.dim.plains.name: The Plains
wiki.under_world.dim.plains.desc:
HOW TO ENTER: Step onto the glowing Pylon Portal Turf directly underneath an Overworld Power Pylon structure.

ENVIRONMENT: Endless rolling pale overcast meadows bisected by a weathered dirt road lined with powerlines, abandoned houses, and concrete apartment blocks.

DANGERS & EXIT: At night, Living Pylons awaken and patrol the plains. Step onto the glowing portal turf pad near spawn to go home, OR climb the distant turbine hill (near X=420, Z=0) and enter the Wind Turbine Core portal into The Wind Ocean!
wiki.under_world.dim.wind_ocean.name: The Wind Ocean
wiki.under_world.dim.wind_ocean.desc:
HOW TO ENTER: Enter the Wind Ocean Portal embedded inside the hilltop Wind Turbine at the far end of The Plains.

ENVIRONMENT: Cold fog-draped endless grey ocean dotted with towering offshore wind turbines. You spawn inside an oak boat on the waves.

DANGERS & EXIT: Wind Turbine Stalkers awaken from the mist and wade after your boat. Sail toward the giant flaming Oil Rig landmark (around X=+144, Z=0), climb the ladder onto the deck, and step into the Oil Rig Escape Portal!
wiki.under_world.dim.xp.name: The Xp
wiki.under_world.dim.xp.desc:
HOW TO ENTER: Right-click an Old CRT Computer block (found in structures or creative menu).

ENVIRONMENT: Iconic Windows XP Bliss landscape with a bright blue sky, green grassy hill, blue taskbar, green Start section, and floating 3D Desktop Shortcut icons.

DANGERS & EXIT: Walking near desktop shortcuts corrupts them with a Windows XP error crash sound, causing black Crashed Shortcut blocks to fall! Walk to the Chrome Monument at (3, 64, -12) to enter The Browser, or click the return Computer near spawn.
wiki.under_world.dim.browser.name: The Browser
wiki.under_world.dim.browser.desc:
HOW TO ENTER: Step through the Chrome Shortcut Portal inside The Xp dimension.

ENVIRONMENT: Endless white webpage grid with an overhead browser address bar HUD showing live URLs (Google Hub, YouTube, Roblox, Steam, Reddit).

CLIMAX & EXIT: Travel to the corrupted website at (+136, -120): 'http://the-MinECRaT-fREe-downladn.com/'. Clicking or approaching the DOWNLOAD NOW button awakens The ___.com AND opens an illuminated escape corridor to the LEFT (-X). Sprint into the Browser Escape Portal to return home with an Old CRT Computer!
wiki.under_world.blocks.computer.name: Old CRT Computer
wiki.under_world.blocks.computer.desc:
An ancient beige CRT monitor & desktop tower.

FUNCTION: Right-clicking it in the Overworld boots you directly into The Xp desktop dimension. Right-clicking the Computer inside The Xp or The Browser brings you back to the Overworld.

REWARD: Successfully escaping The ___.com trap in The Browser rewards you with an Old CRT Computer directly into your inventory.
wiki.under_world.blocks.portals.name: All Dimension Portals
wiki.under_world.blocks.portals.desc:
• Pylon Portal Turf -> Warps between Overworld Power Pylons and The Plains.
• Wind Ocean Portal -> Inside The Plains hill turbine, warps into The Wind Ocean.
• Rig Escape Portal -> Atop the Oil Rig deck in Wind Ocean, returns to Overworld.
• Maze Rift Portal -> Red rift in Fun World leading to Maze.
• Maze Escape Terminal -> End terminal in Maze returning to Overworld.
• Temporal Exit Portal -> Clock portal inside The Time returning home.
• Chrome Shortcut Portal -> Inside The Xp, opens The Browser.
• Browser Escape Portal -> Left escape corridor in Browser Trap.
wiki.under_world.blocks.fun_maze.name: Fun World & Maze Blocks
wiki.under_world.blocks.fun_maze.desc:
• Fun Grass Block & Fun Dirt: Oversaturated bright turf & soil of The Fun World.
• Fun Grass Tuft, Blue/Red Mushrooms & Yellow/Blue/Flat Flowers: Classic surreal flora.
• Maze Red Brick, Maze Wood Floor, Maze Office Ceiling: The claustrophobic construction materials of Maze corridors.
wiki.under_world.blocks.error_time.name: Error & Time Blocks
wiki.under_world.blocks.error_time.desc:
• Error Surface Block & Corrupted Soil: Fractured terrain of The Error.
• Glitch Block: Neon purple/cyan/yellow corrupted cube found in Glitch Clusters and Error Wastes.
• Clock Dial Block & Clock Bronze Frame: Ornamental disc blocks forming the floating platforms overhead in The Time.
wiki.under_world.blocks.plains_ocean.des:
• Endless Plains Turf & Weathered Plains Road: Terrain of The Plains.
• Galvanized Pylon Steel: Cross-braced metal blocks forming Power Pylons.
• Offshore Turbine Pillar & Turbine Rotor Blade: Composite white turbine structures.
• Rusted Oil Rig Steel: Heavy weathered metal plating of the Wind Ocean extraction rig.
wiki.under_world.blocks.xp_browser.name: Desktop & Webpage Blocks
wiki.under_world.blocks.xp_browser.desc:
• Bliss Hill Turf, Desktop Shortcut Block & Crashed Shortcut Block: The Xp's green wallpaper hill and falling black error icons.
• Webpage Background Tile & Browser Top Bar: Clean grid tiles and navigation framing.
• Site Blocks (YouTube, Roblox, Steam, Reddit, Corrupted Site): Domain-colored sectors of The Browser.
• DOWNLOAD NOW Button: Glowing emerald trap trigger that awakens The ___.com.
wiki.under_world.blocks.effects.name: Spawn Eggs & Effects
wiki.under_world.blocks.effects.desc:
• Creative Tab 'Under World': Contains every custom block plus all 14 colored entity Spawn Eggs.
• Effect 'Geometric Nightmare' (under_world:geometric_nightmare): Inflicted by The Ball. Warps camera tilt, renders geometric overlay flashes, and triggers surreal sound distortion.
wiki.under_world.struct.worldgen.name: Overworld Structures (10)
wiki.under_world.struct.worldgen.desc:
1. Power Pylon: Tall galvanized steel tower carrying a Pylon Portal Turf pad.
2. Void Shrine: Dark obsidian-like altar that pulls standing players into The Fun World.
3. Clock Statue: Eerie monument marking clock's influence.
4. Elongated Tree: Unnaturally tall tree variant.
5. Broken Shaft: Abandoned mineshaft ruin.
6. Leaf Maze: Overgrown hedge labyrinth.
7. Glitch Cluster: Corrupted Glitch Block formations.
8. Old Village House, Wheat Farm & Fountain: Nostalgic abandoned Alpha/Beta remnants.
wiki.under_world.struct.power_pylon.name: Power Pylon & Portal
wiki.under_world.struct.power_pylon.tag: Gateway to The Plains -> Wind Ocean
wiki.under_world.struct.power_pylon.desc:
Generates in plains, meadows, savannas, and forests. Underneath its four splayed steel legs lies glowing Pylon Portal Turf.

PROGRESSION CHAIN:
Overworld Power Pylon -> The Plains -> Hill Wind Turbine Core -> The Wind Ocean -> Offshore Oil Rig Escape Portal -> Overworld!
wiki.under_world.struct.void_shrine.name: Void Shrine
wiki.under_world.struct.void_shrine.tag: Gateway to The Fun World -> Maze
wiki.under_world.struct.void_shrine.desc:
Spawns rarely in forests, taigas, plains, and dark forests.

PROGRESSION CHAIN:
Overworld Void Shrine -> The Fun World -> Red Brick Maze Rift -> Maze -> Glowing Maze Escape Terminal -> Overworld!
wiki.under_world.struct.lore_builds.name: Dynamic Lore Structures (8)
wiki.under_world.struct.lore_builds.desc:
During survival gameplay (every few minutes when enabled), abandoned server builds appear around you telling the story of the lost 2013-2015 server 'UnderCraft':

• Kira_99's Hillside House
• Secret Clan Base & Admin Bunker
• Dima_2015's Unfinished Mario Pixel Art
• Old Server Memorial Monument
• Misha_Play's Oak Treehouse
• Alex_2014's Hidden Dugout
• Old Spawn Hub & Rule Board
• Trader_Vova's Quarantined Market
• Old CRT Computer Desk
wiki.under_world.struct.books.name: Lore Signs & Written Books
wiki.under_world.struct.books.desc: Every dynamic lore structure contains chests and lecterns holding signed books written by Kira_99, Admin_Max, Dima_2015, Misha_Play, Alex_2014, and Trader_Vova — revealing how 'friend' arrived, how Misha was taken by the_mimic, and warning players never to click DOWNLOAD inside The Browser.
wiki.under_world.events.friend_day1.name: friend Join & Chat AI
wiki.under_world.events.friend_day1.desc:
• Joins once automatically on Day 1 evening and adds 'friend' to the player Tab list.
• Responds dynamically in chat to keywords: 'hello', 'who are you?', 'void', 'hands', 'tree', 'the sky', 'fun world', 'smile'.
• PUNISHMENT SYSTEM: Typing insults directed at friend triggers lightning strikes, explosions, or falling high-altitude anvils!
wiki.under_world.events.hell.name: welcome to the hell
wiki.under_world.events.hell.desc:
A super-rare night event on the surface: the sky turns blindingly dark with Darkness/Blindness/Nausea, a ring of crimson flames and spores erupts, a visual lightning bolt strikes nearby, and '<...> welcome to the hell.' prints in crimson bold text.

Surviving it unlocks the advancement 'welcome to the hell'.
wiki.under_world.events.rules.name: Spawn Rules & Protections
wiki.under_world.events.rules.desc:
• ANTI-SPAWN-KILL: When an Under World creature kills a player, it automatically vanishes on respawn and grants temporary spawn protection so you are never trapped in a death loop.
• BED ERROR WARP: Sleeping in an Overworld bed has a 20% configurable chance to pull you into The Error.
• PAUSE / TOGGLE: Events can be toggled anytime with /underworld events toggle.
wiki.under_world.events.audio.name: Music & Horror Audio
wiki.under_world.events.audio.desc:
Over 30 custom sound effects including Pylon 50Hz hums, electrical arcs, offshore turbine whooshes, Windows XP startup & error crashes, grandfather clock chimes, and monster roars.

Each of the 8 dimensions (plus eerie Overworld night piano/wind) features its own dedicated background music track.
wiki.under_world.cmd.spawn_trigger.name: /underworld spawn & trigger
wiki.under_world.cmd.spawn_trigger.desc:
Requires OP level 2:
• /underworld spawn <entity> — Spawns any of the 14 entities 15-20 blocks nearby (friend, hands, tree_mimic, the_sky, eyes_of_fun, smile, the_truth, clock, the_mimic, demon_fish, the_ball, living_pylon, wind_turbine_stalker, the_dot_com).
• /underworld trigger <event> — Manually triggers friend_join, friend_chat, any monster encounter, or welcome_to_the_hell.
wiki.under_world.cmd.dim_struct.name: /underworld dimension & structure
wiki.under_world.cmd.dim_struct.desc:
• /underworld dimension <player> <dim> — Teleports directly to overworld, the_fun_world, maze, the_error, the_time, the_plains, the_wind_ocean, the_xp, or the_browser.
• /underworld structure <name> — Spawns any worldgen structure or dynamic lore build nearby (power_pylon, void_shrine, kira_house, clan_base, mario_art, monument, treehouse, dugout, spawn_hub, trading_hall, computer_desk, etc.).
wiki.under_world.cmd.events_reset.name: /underworld events & reset
wiki.under_world.cmd.events_reset.desc:
• /underworld events status — Displays whether automatic events are enabled and if friend has joined.
• /underworld events toggle <true|false> — Enables or pauses all automatic horror events in the world.
• /underworld reset friend — Resets the Day 1 friend join state so the event can occur again.
wiki.under_world.cmd.config.name: Configuration & Cloth Config
wiki.under_world.cmd.config.desc: Every single entity chance, speed, chase timer, Fun World 4x clock speed, bed Error chance (0.20), Error buffer timer (1800 ticks), Anti-Spawn-Kill toggle, Dynamic Structure frequency, and Custom Music toggle can be customized inside config/under_world-common.toml or via the in-game Mods -> Config screen (Cloth Config supported).
